title: Introduction to Human Dimensions
text:
Welcome to NRES 315
Human dimensions asks how people, institutions, values, evidence, and ethics shape fish and wildlife management.

Introduce the course as a way of making management reasoning more visible. Canvas remains the authoritative source for course administration.

title: Introduction to Human Dimensions
text:
A recurring management question

What decision is being made, what evidence matters, who is affected, and which tradeoffs must be addressed?

title: Introduction to Human Dimensions
text:
Today’s starting points

Management decisions affect people, habitats, and species.
Evidence can clarify consequences, but it does not choose values or priorities.
Different affected publics may reasonably see the same decision differently.

title: Introduction to Human Dimensions

title: Introduction to Human Dimensions
text:
Before you leave
Bring one management question to the next class: What evidence would you need, whose perspective might be missing, and what tradeoff could follow?
